Private Dining And Parties

Private Dining and Parties at The Quicken Tree

In addition to our main restaurant, The Quicken Tree offers a variety of private rooms and spaces perfect for private dining or parties. We also cater for wakes and memorial gatherings, whether you’re planning an intimate gathering or a larger celebration of life.  Depending on the size of your party and budget, we can accommodate up to 600 guests comfortably.

Smaller Private Hire Rooms

For small intimate gatherings, we suggest the Pine Suite, Cedar, Dome  Willow,  Dining Dome,Tipi, and 
THE PARTY-POD

The hire charge is £200 for a 4-hour booking per room, except for the Tipi, which can hold more people and starts from £900. Each booking includes exclusive use of the space. If you’d like to decorate your tables, our team can arrange early access for you. After your event, we’ll also take care of disposing of any rubbish left behind.

Each room is unique with lots to offer. To view the rooms, please book a showround with one of our team who will be happy to assist and advise on which room will serve you best.

The Birchley Suite and Large Marquee

We offer package prices on the larger rooms with the room hire built in to the cost of your food per head. This is based on you signing the contract for a minimum spend. In other words you would need to contract on minimum numbers of people attending. Our team can advise on what this is likely to be on each room.

We have optional extras in abundance so if you fancy a western themed shindig, we have all the theming and props you could wish for. We have props and themes for all tastes so please ask one of our team who will be happy to advise. Want fun casino tables, a bucking bronco, maybe sumo wrestling suits or a bouncy castle, we have it all on site so please ask for details.

We often get asked by customers if they can supply their own catering. Unfortunately the answer is no, unless you require something our chefs couldn’t do. An example of this would be Asian food where external professional caterers with all the correct accreditation can be brought in however, there would be a kitchen hire charge.

Our chefs are very accommodating and regularly create bespoke menus for parties so don’t be frightened to ask about this when booking. We are in the throws of pulling new menus together including buffet menus and full sit down banquet menus. We will add them to this page as they become available.

To talk to the team about a private booking on numbers over 15, please call 01676 540333 and we will be happy to assist.

THE PINE SUITE

The Pine Suite at The Quicken Tree is a beautiful room connected to the main restaurant but with its own access too. With wooden floors and a twinkly starlight ceiling, lots of customers choose the Pine as their room of choice for private dining. This room can be set up with round tables or rectangles, in banqueting style or as a u shape. Talk to the team about numbers and they can advise on which set-up suits your party size best.

TEAM MEET THE

Meet The Quicken Tree Team

Ever wondered who the team are that serve you whenever you visit The Quicken Tree? Here we plan to highlight our staff so you can find out just a little bit about them. We will be adding to this page as we go.

Meet our new Restaurant Manager Mario

After starting out as a Holiday entertainer in Cyprus, Mario found his love for travel, guest satisfaction and going the extra mile.
After coming back to the UK in 2007, he quickly found a job in Hospitality, and the rest as they say, is history.
Starting as a Bartender, his drive and passion for food and drink soon had him on track to progression.

During his career he has opened a restaurant, overseen the refurbishment of a bar & lounge, updated and implemented new menus, till systems, overseen large scale weddings and launch events, as well as more intimate private dining settings, creating speciality and themed cocktails for events and much more.

His strong focus on his team is fundamental to his success. He has trained, developed and progressed many of his team members over the years.

Of course it goes without saying, his main focus is Customer Service and creating those unexpected Moments of Delight. With a passion for delivering an outstanding guest experience, he likes to make every guest feel like a VIP.

Welcome to the team Mario

Welcome to our new Head Chef Stefan Elliot

We’re delighted to welcome Stefan Elliot as Head Chef at The Quicken Tree, at The Heart of England Conference & Events Centre in Coventry.

Stefan brings a wealth of experience from some exceptional kitchens across the UK and Spain. His culinary journey began on a Lancashire cheese farm, where he learned to make the famous Mrs Kirkham’s Lancashire Cheese, before a chance encounter at a food festival led to his first professional kitchen role.

After working alongside respected chefs including Warrick Dodds and Marc Guilbert, Stefan spread his wings and headed to Spain, spending time in Madrid and working in the kitchen of acclaimed chef Sergi Arola. The experience had a huge influence on his cooking, introducing him to new ingredients, flavours and techniques.

Today, Stefan’s style combines that experience with a refreshingly straightforward philosophy: great ingredients, familiar dishes and plenty of flavour, always with his own twist.

With a Spanish wife, Mediterranean food remains a big influence both at home and in his cooking, while chefs including Gordon Ramsay and Tom Kerridge have also inspired him throughout his career.

At The Quicken Tree, Stefan wants to create food that feels special without being overly complicated or formal – whether you’re joining us for breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, Sunday lunch or dinner.

His best advice for any cook?

“Keep things simple, taste and season as you go.”

Now Stefan is bringing everything he has learned throughout his career to The Quicken Tree, with exciting plans for the menus and plenty of delicious things to come.

Posh Pod booking terms and conditions

All Posh Pod bookings will have a maximum of 3 hours table time due to high demand and will require pre-booking.

These 3 hour time slots will be strictly adhered to for us to ensure that the pods are fully cleaned, disinfected and sanitised ready for the next bookings.

The pod is available to hire up until 10pm at which time you will be requied to vacate the Pod in order for us to adhere to current government guidelines for pubs and restaurants.

The room hire charge is £100 for 3 hours and will be required at the time of booking to secure your booking. This is a strict non-refundable charge. If you can’t attend on the date and time booked, you will be able to re-arrange providing you give us 48hrs notice. 

We require a £100.00 minimum spend on food and drinks and only drinks or food purchased from the Quicken Tree can be consumed on the premises.

NO smoking inside the pod.

Children are welcome in the pod
